The conversation so far:
Developer: patient approved my consent request, what next
You: The notify callback on your HIU bridge carries consentArtefacts with the artefact ids. Fetch the artefact with /api/hiecm/consent/v3/fetch and then request the health information.

The developer's new message:
there were two ids in it, do i need both

spec.description: This API endpoint is used to fetch all consent artefact details associated with a specific consent request ID. By invoking this API, users can retrieve comprehensive information about all consent artefacts linked to the given request ID, including their status, scope, and any associated conditions. This functionality is essential for ensuring that users have access to accurate and up-to-date consent artefact information, supporting secure and compliant health information exchange. The API facilitates efficient management and verification of consent artefacts, enhancing the overall integrity of the consent management process.

spec.summary: This is ABDM HIE-CM API called to fetch all the consent artefact details associated with a consent request request-id.

reply.Text:
You need **both** artefact IDs. A single consent request can create multiple consent artefacts — typically one per HIP (health information provider) you requested data from. When you fetch each artefact by its ID using `/api/hiecm/consent/v3/artefact/{artefactId}`, you get the scope, permissions, and which HIP it covers. Then use both artefacts to request health information from their respective HIPs.

Check what each artefact's `hip.id` is — that tells you which provider each one is for.
